criteria.label: Distinct empirical source
criteria.definition: Not a duplicate, staging copy or administrative package of another entry.

criteria.label: Organisational episode
criteria.definition: Concerns an organisation (SME or larger), not private/personal use.

criteria.label: Inside archive window
criteria.definition: Dated within the frozen archive window (2024-01-01 to 2026-08-24).

criteria.label: Lawful research access
criteria.definition: Records sit in a drive/mailbox whose controller assessment is signed. KVKK pending = Unknown (held, not excluded).

criteria.label: Materiality
criteria.definition: Material specialised asset or capital episode (threshold defined in §3.1).

criteria.label: Reconstructable chronology
criteria.definition: A contemporaneous chronology can be reconstructed from dated documents.

criteria.label: Sufficient evidence
criteria.definition: At least one contemporaneous transactional or correspondence source.

criteria.label: Financing/payment architecture OR defined comparator role
criteria.definition: Either a meaningful financing/payment architecture, or a comparator role defined before outcomes were examined.

criteria.label: Financing route evaluated
criteria.definition: Episode-level evidence that at least one financing route was evaluated.

criteria.label: Ex-ante timing evidence
criteria.definition: Timing expectations documented before the outcome; never inferred from realised latency.

criteria.label: Window Tier A/B
criteria.definition: Tier A or B action window (protocol lock: Tier C is descriptive/sensitivity only).

criteria.label: Window documented before outcome
criteria.definition: The window endpoint tW is documented in a source dated before the outcome.

criteria.label: Required event R by tW
criteria.definition: The event R that had to occur by tW is explicit.

criteria.label: Mature outcome
criteria.definition: Outcome complete or mature enough to classify without speculation.

criteria.label: Triangulation
criteria.definition: ≥2 source types, or 1 strong external source plus independent corroboration.

criteria.label: Separable clocks
criteria.definition: Finance, payment, fulfilment, logistics and operational clocks can be dated separately.
